description: COACTVWC ENTER cold start: 0000-MAIN's EIBCALEN = 0 arm, the FIRST disjunct of the guard at :282-284, which no other COACTVWC case takes. No commarea travelled, so :285-286 INITIALIZEs CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, leaving CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 0 and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER true. EIBAID is DFHENTER, so YYYY-STORE-PFKEY at :299-300 (the COPY 'CSSTRPFY' at :913) yields ENTER, the gate at :306-314 accepts it as PFK-VALID and remaps nothing, and the order-sensitive EVALUATE TRUE at :323 - arms :324 PFK03, :353 CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, :361 CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, :375 OTHER - lands on the SECOND arm at :353. That arm performs 1000-SEND-MAP through the benign range PERFORM at :358-359 and leaves by the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN at :360, which returns pseudo-conversationally at :402-406 with TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID). 1000-SEND-MAP at :416-425 runs 1100-SCREEN-INIT at :431, 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS at :460, 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS at :541 and 1400-SEND-SCREEN at :577 in that order. This is the FULL 37-field assertion: every xxxO item is pinned at the width its xxxI item declares in app/cpy-bms/COACTVW.CPY, and the 29 the program never writes are pinned as LOW-VALUES - rendered as literal U+0000 characters, one per byte, because MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CACTVWAO at :432 put x'00' there and the differ compares the bytes, so they are neither spaces nor a zero-filled edit mask such as '+           .00'. The six 1100 writes are byte-exact: TITLE01O and TITLE02O from CCDA-TITLE01 and the ACTIVE CCDA-TITLE02 at app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:19 and :22 (:21 is commented out), TRNNAMEO and PGMNAMEO from LIT-THISTRANID at :146 and LIT-THISPGM at :144, and CURDATEO 07/19/22 with CURTIMEO 23:15:58 from the clock this case pins - the source revision's own timestamp, COTTL01Y.cpy:26 'Date: 2022-07-19 23:15:58 CDT' - never a captured wall clock. 1200's outer test at :462 is EIBCALEN and not the context flag, so it takes the prompt arm at :463 and never enters the field-population ELSE at :464-525: ACCTSIDO stays LOW-VALUES rather than blank, which is the single most plausible place to go wrong here. Its closing moves at :532 and :534 are the only reason ERRMSGO and INFOMSGO are not LOW-VALUES: WS-RETURN-MSG X(75) is SPACES from SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF at :278 and reaches ERRMSGO PIC X(78) as 78 spaces, and WS-INFO-MSG X(40) holds the exactly-40-character 88 WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT literal at :113-114 and reaches INFOMSGO PIC X(45) with five more spaces. Both are pinned on the send channel at those declared widths, 78 and 45, rather than in expectedMessages, because MessageChannel publishes no 45-byte channel and the message channel belongs to the SEND-PLAIN-TEXT path this case never reaches. 1300 sets ACCTSIDC to DFHDFCOL at :555 and INFOMSGC to DFHNEUTR through the ELSE at :570 because an info message is now present; its cursor EVALUATE at :546-552 has identical bodies on both arms, MOVE -1 TO ACCTSIDL either way, and that oddity is preserved rather than collapsed. WS-EDIT-ACCT-FLAG is a space after INITIALIZE, so FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true, yet the highlight at :561-565 is guarded by AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and the context is still ENTER when 1300 runs - no '*' and no DFHRED, the negative half of the entry-versus-re-entry contract. 1400 then names mapset COACTVW and map CACTVWA at :579-580 and SETs CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE at :581 BEFORE the send, so the returned context is 1 and the next turn re-enters; nextProgram is absent because MOVE LIT-THISPGM TO CCARD-NEXT-PROG lives at :602 inside 2000-PROCESS-INPUTS, which this arm never performs. Nothing is written - the program's only file verbs are the three EXEC CICS READs at :727, :776 and :826 - and none of them runs on this path either, so expectedWrites is empty and every seeded row is pinned unchanged on the final-state channel instead. CARDDAT and CARDAIX are declared as literals at :187 and :191 and never named by any EXEC CICS command, so they are neither seeded nor asserted and no CardRepository exists to seed them into; the inconsistency is recorded, not tidied. PROVENANCE: every expected value here was derived STATICALLY, by structured reading of those paragraphs - 0000-MAIN :262-:402 and COMMON-RETURN :394-:406, 1100-SCREEN-INIT, 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS, 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS and 1400-SEND-SCREEN - and cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts (CVACT01Y 300, CVACT02Y 150, CVACT03Y 50, CVCUS01Y 500), the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTVW.CPY and the real app/data/ASCII fixtures. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: COBOL cannot be executed in this environment, and this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline.
